classification.difficultyReason: Align a protractor with differently oriented arms, select the correct scale and use each measurement in a subtraction from 360 degrees to obtain its reflex angle.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use your protractor to find the approximate size of each of these angles. Be careful to place the centre of the semicircle precisely over the vertex of the angle.

spec.description: Unlabelled acute angle with vertex at lower right, horizontal arm extending left and another arm extending up-left. The smaller sector is marked.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle approximately 42 degrees; no numerical value is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle value is hidden; only the arms and arc are supplied.

answer.worked: Place the protractor centre over the vertex and align its baseline with the leftward horizontal arm. Read from $0^\circ$ on that arm to the other arm: approximately $42^\circ$.

spec.description: Unlabelled obtuse angle with a rightward horizontal arm and an up-left arm. The upper obtuse sector is marked.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle approximately 122 degrees; no numerical value is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle value is hidden; only the arms and arc are supplied.

answer.worked: Place the protractor centre over the vertex and align its baseline with the rightward horizontal arm. Read from $0^\circ$ on that arm to the other arm: approximately $122^\circ$. The marked angle is obtuse.

spec.description: Unlabelled acute angle at an upper-right vertex. One arm extends left and slightly down; the other extends steeply down-left. The smaller sector is marked.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle approximately 56 degrees; no numerical value is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle value is hidden; only the arms and arc are supplied.

answer.worked: Place the protractor centre over the vertex and align its baseline with either arm. Read from $0^\circ$ on that arm to the other arm through the marked sector: approximately $56^\circ$.

spec.description: Unlabelled obtuse angle with one arm extending steeply up-right and the other down-left. The upper-left sector is marked.
spec.mathematics: Marked angle approximately 134 degrees; no numerical value is printed.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle value is hidden; only the arms and arc are supplied.

answer.worked: Place the protractor centre over the vertex and align its baseline with either arm. Read from $0^\circ$ on that arm through the marked obtuse sector to the other arm: approximately $134^\circ$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Write down the size of the reflex angle in each of the subparts i–iv of part a.
